sourceText: Drive the trusted-RED-evidence subsystem spec (docs/requirements/decisions/red-evidence-subsystem-spec.md, DONE on main) to implementation, decomposed into 9 leaves (.lattice/tmp/w2-decomposition.json). W2c is Workstream 2 area 3: §1.10 v2 record schema, §3.1-§3.7 chain plane (head uniqueness, integrity checks, transition table, operation keys, dedupe ordering, edge cases), and §4.1 quarantine/recover — while never crashing the live enforce gate.
normalizedOutcome: red_evidence_quarantine and red_evidence_recover exist, the v2 record + chain plane is implemented, and the live enforce gate tolerates v2 records with byte-identical v1 diagnostics; the committed chain smoke passes.
acceptanceClaim: The committed red-evidence-chain-smoke passes and the live enforce gate produces byte-identical diagnostics on a v1-only store while tolerating v2 records.
